title: BlobPlan's Personal Modpack
description: A modpack with mods and texturepacks that I like to use with vanilla minecraft.
body:
This modpack was originally made just for me to have fun. But I decided to publish it so others can try it out too! You can also use this in any server as It doesn't have any heavily modded stuff.

- Entity Texture Features
